# Synthetic audit fixture: AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO) start URL.
# Scheme and DNS host are case-insensitive (RFC 3986/1035), so the
# mixed-case spellings below are the same identifying URL as the
# lowercase one and must be flagged too; /start stays case-sensitive.
start_url = "https://d-a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i.awsapps.com/start"
start_url_mixed = "HTTPS://D-A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8I.AWSAPPS.COM/start"
start_url_host_case = "https://D-A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8I.AwsApps.Com/start"
